functionalRequirement: The website shall provide forms for certificates so users can request certificates online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The website must include all necessary fields for certificate requests, covering 100% of the required information as specified in the certificate application process.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a complete form for certificate requests, ensuring all necessary data is captured.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The website must validate all form inputs according to predefined rules, ensuring 99.9% accuracy in data entry for certificate requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and accurate data submission for certificate requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The website must process certificate request submissions within 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, requiring quick processing to maintain a positive user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The certificate request form must be accessible via a clear and prominent link on the website's main navigation, with intuitive field labels and instructions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction with forms, which should be easy to navigate and use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The website must provide real-time validation and error messages for incorrect or missing form inputs, preventing submission of incomplete certificate requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves form submission, which should minimize user errors through immediate feedback.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The website must be available for certificate requests 99.9% of the time during operational hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the certificate request service, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All data entered into the certificate request form must be encrypted using HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or higher.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive user data, which requires protection during transmission.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The website must ensure that certificate request data is not altered during transmission or storage, using SHA-256 checksums.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical data that must remain unaltered for the certificate process.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to manage privacy settings such as who can view their profile, connections, and sharing data with third parties.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide options for managing all specified privacy settings, covering 100% of the privacy aspects mentioned in the FR.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive privacy management options for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must correctly apply privacy settings as selected by the user, ensuring 99.9% accuracy in privacy setting enforcement.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate implementation of user-selected privacy settings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The privacy settings interface must be accessible via a clear and prominent link in the user's profile settings, with intuitive controls and clear labels.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with privacy settings, which should be easy to navigate and use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide immediate feedback and confirmation for changes to privacy settings, preventing unintended modifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user settings, which should minimize errors through immediate feedback.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The privacy settings management feature must be available 99.9% of the time during operational hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to privacy settings, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All privacy settings and associated data must be encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2 or higher during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive user data, which requires protection at rest and during transmission.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that privacy settings data is not altered during transmission or storage, using SHA-256 checksums.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical data that must remain unaltered for privacy management.

functionalRequirement: System shall set over temperature values to prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must monitor and adjust temperatures across all relevant components, covering 100% of the temperature control scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive temperature monitoring and adjustment to prevent deviations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must set over temperature values with an accuracy of within 0.5 degrees Fahrenheit for 99.9% of temperature readings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise temperature control to prevent deviations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must detect and respond to temperature deviations within 1 second to prevent exceeding the 3-degree threshold.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time temperature monitoring and control, requiring timely responses.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must continue to monitor and adjust temperatures even in the event of a single sensor failure, ensuring 99.9% uptime of temperature control functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires continuous temperature control, which must be resilient to failures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operational Constraint: The system must maintain temperatures within the specified range to prevent equipment damage or safety hazards.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves temperature control to ensure safe operation of equipment.

functionalRequirement: System shall show the first lines of news articles based on the titles on the title screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display the first lines of news articles for 100% of the titles shown on the title screen.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive display of article excerpts for all titles.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately match the first lines of news articles to their corresponding titles with 99.9% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for correct and accurate display of article excerpts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must load and display the first lines of news articles within 500 milliseconds for 95% of requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with news content, requiring quick display for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for navigating between titles and their corresponding first lines, with consistent formatting and layout.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with news content, which should be easy to navigate and use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to display the first lines of news articles 99.9% of the time during operational hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to news content, necessitating high availability.
